title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.15.0 adds an English Week 10.2 laboratory that trains a characteristic-integral BGK PINN from random initialization on the CPU. Students control network depth and width, Adam/L-BFGS/hybrid optimization and conserved-moment loss weights. An independent NumPy reduced-BGK MUSCL/minmod-SSPRK2 DVM is evaluated only after training. Seven declared demonstrations retain initialized and trained physical profiles, individual loss components, computational work, reference errors and failures; paired spatial references and separate quadrature checks measure numerical sensitivity without a blanket convergence claim. An expanded lecture connects the trainable model with the retained BGK/Shakhov and stationary Mach-2 scientific evidence. Earlier course and cavity studies remain available with their stated limitations. New teaching software is MIT licensed; upstream research inputs retain their own attribution and license scope.
